calculate_symplectic_score: calculate the symplecticity score of a physics model by finding the best polynomial expansion and evaluating the Jacobian
find_best_polynomial: find the minimal polynomial expansion using Lasso regression that explains enough variance in target data
create_latent_mask: create a boolean mask identifying informative latent dimensions from a distrax Normal distribution
compute_jacobian_manual: compute the Jacobian matrix manually from polynomial features and their regression weights
do_grid_search: run a grid search with cross-validation to find the best Lasso regression alpha parameter
